description: SourceProof checks how well supplied web pages support a claim, using keyword matching with citation snippets. It does not establish that a claim is true. POST JSON to /v1/verify with claim and 1-10 HTTP(S) source URLs on ports 80 or 443; returns a support verdict (supported, contradicted, partially_supported, or insufficient_evidence), confidence, citations, retrieval timestamps, and per-source errors. Identical inputs produce deterministic verdict logic, while timestamps and live source content may change.

rpc_types.backend_hint: SourceProof HTTP server on :8080; mount at /
rpc_types.notes: Only GET and HEAD on /, GET /v1/version, GET and HEAD on /health, GET and HEAD on /openapi.json, and POST /v1/verify are expected. Every response is a JSON object.

specs.notes: OpenAPI contract for SourceProof, addressed by the v0.1.2 release tag.

serving.backend: The supplier-hosted sourceproof container behind a Pocket HA RelayMiner, with the RelayMiner backend_url pointed at the supplier's reachable backend address and port 8080. No backend authentication is required; requests are bounded and source URLs are SSRF-checked.

healthcheck.notes: Identity probe pins the backend to SourceProof.
Functional probe: the public source must be fetched and must support the claim. A failed fetch returns insufficient_evidence, which fails this probe.

serving.notes: Suppliers should allow the RelayMiner to reach the backend, set a request timeout of at least 10 seconds (the service enforces an 8 second total deadline per request), run the container as provided (non-root, with its Docker health check), set SOURCEPROOF_BLOCKED_IPS to the server’s own public IP so callers cannot make it connect back to its host, and apply external rate limiting for public production traffic. Sources are limited to ports 80 and 443.
